title: Cargo Compartment Lining Panel — Installation

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of cargo compartment lining panels with a continuous intumescent seal at every joint and penetration, followed by the smoke detection sampling performance check for the compartment.

sections.purpose: This task gives the installation of cargo compartment lining panels, the sealing of the joints and penetrations, and the checks that must be complete before the compartment is returned to service.
sections.job_setup_note: Confirm which panel standard is being fitted; the flame penetration resistant panel is thicker and needs the revised anchor nut pitch on the compartment ceiling. Check the shelf life date on the intumescent tape before you start, because an out-of-life tape will not intumesce and the compartment will not meet its certification. Work from the aft bulkhead forward.
sections.procedure: Confirm that the compartment lighting is isolated and that all structural findings from the removal task are closed. Install the anchor nuts EN513769-76 at the ceiling positions, using the pitch of the applicable illustration. Offer the aft bulkhead decor panel D2550136675057 and the restraint lining together and fit them before any other panel. CAUTION: CHECK THE SHELF LIFE DATE ON THE INTUMESCENT TAPE BEFORE YOU APPLY IT. AN OUT-OF-LIFE TAPE WILL NOT INTUMESCE AND THE COMPARTMENT WILL NOT MEET ITS CERTIFICATION. Fit the lifting frame to each ceiling panel and install the panels working forward, torquing the fasteners to the value in the illustration. Apply the intumescent tape at every panel joint and at every penetration, keeping the tape continuous around a corner. WARNING: DO NOT LEAVE A PENETRATION UNSEALED, EVEN TEMPORARILY, IF THE AIRCRAFT MAY BE MOVED. AN UNSEALED PENETRATION DEFEATS THE COMPARTMENT FIRE CONTAINMENT. Refit the light assemblies D2550007254418 and reconnect their harnesses. Refit the seat track cover at FIN 12DL at the loading floor. Restore the compartment lighting and check every light. Refit the loading system rollers and check that each turns freely. Do the smoke detection sampling performance check for the compartment.
sections.close_out: Confirm that every joint and penetration carries a continuous intumescent seal, and record the tape batch number used. Record the sampling performance check result. Confirm that the compartment lighting works at every position and that no roller binds. Close the technical log entry made at removal.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Use the revised anchor nut pitch and the thicker panel dimensions for the flame penetration resistant standard.

safety_precautions: Do not leave a penetration unsealed if the aircraft may be moved.
Check the intumescent tape shelf life before you start.
Isolate the compartment lighting until installation is complete.
